verdict.rationale: Qodo automatically reviews every PR in the background once connected (qodo-docs-1), applying fixes and enforcing standards autonomously without manual triggering, and this is corroborated by an official MCP server and CLI enabling further automation hooks (qodo-probe-3, qodo-probe-4). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of fully unattended long-running automations, and more detail on scheduling/triggers beyond PR events.
